reviews.title: Great buy
reviews.comment: This fan matched my setup and has been working great.  Colors are chargeable, overall  great fan and price.
reviews.author: JaimeM

reviews.title: Amazing fans. Would get again.
reviews.comment: These fans are amazing. I replaced all my fans in my pc with the single, double and triple core fans. They are silent as can be even if they’re on max speed (which I have to manually turn on cause they’re so efficient my pc always stays cool) and the rgb is beautiful on these bad boys.
reviews.author: Brandon

reviews.title: Quality fans and easy installation
reviews.comment: Another great product from NZXT. They are always are the forefront of peripheral design, and the F420 is not exception. Turning a bulky and cumbersome triple fan intake setup into a single frame with 1 wire is amazing. RGB looks great and noise levels are low. Recommend!
reviews.author: Tyler rohrman
